name: Talhindir's Grief

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor

disable: DC 17 Performance check (trained) to overpower the frightening cries with a greater sound or DC 15 Occultism check or DC 15 Religion check (trained) to ritually disrupt the haunting.
reset: If the haunt is not dispersed, it resets after 1 day.

items.name: The Falling Tears
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the carving of Viore Ciobanu

---
Effect The fungus statues weep blood, and their cries deal 2d6+5 mental damage to living creatures within the room (DC 17 basic Will save save). On a failed save, creatures are also Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure)

text: Gentle crying rises to become overwhelming wails. The fungal carvings begin to weep blood that pools around the pillars
